Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
Your mission
 We’re expanding our international footprint and are currently building a new Tech Hub in Romania . As part of this growing engineering team, you’ll play a key role in developing modern, scalable backend systems and cloud-based solutions for clients across Europe.
Backend Development: Design, implement, and maintain robust backend services using Python or other server-side technologies
API Integration: Build, integrate, and manage APIs for seamless data exchange between various services
DevOps Collaboration: Work closely with our DevOps team to automate deployment processes and implement CI/CD pipelines
Code Reviews & Documentation: Ensure code quality, maintainability, and proper documentation through peer reviews and clean coding practices
Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other developers to deliver impactful solutions
Cloud-based Development: Develop and implement highly scalable applications in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud)
Build intelligent AI applications that create real business impact
Database Management: Design and maintain both relational and non-relational databases
 Your profile
Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Backend or Fullstack Developer with Python 
Solid understanding of cloud computing and containerized applications
Experience with DevOps tools (e.g., Docker, Jenkins, GitLab CI) is a plus
Knowledge of container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes) is an advantage
Ideally, some initial exposure to RAG, vector databases, or LangChain
Strong communication skills in English (German is a plus but not required)
 What We Offer
Flexibility: Work fully remote from anywhere in Romania or join us at one of our partner coworking spaces.
Coworking Budget: We cover the monthly cost for a coworking space near you.
Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary plus an annual RON 15.000 training budget, performance-based bonuses, and a wide range of benefits.
Modern Equipment: The latest hardware (including MacBook Pro) and modern software tools for efficient remote collaboration.
Premium Health Insurance
Additional benefits: To be defined jointly as we grow the team
 Location
 This role is remote-first . You can work from home anywhere in Romania or make use of our new Tech Hub in Romania . Our German offices in Berlin, Munich, and Grünwald are also available for occasional visits. Most client work is done remotely.
 About Us
 About us – Pexon Consulting GmbH
Welcome to Pexon Consulting, your digital highway. From initial strategy to full implementation, we develop modern cloud and AI landscapes for businesses. Thanks to our robust and compliant infrastructure, our customers can develop intelligent applications and scale them effectively.
As a leading provider of cloud and AI services, our mission is to actively shape our customers' digital transformation with innovative, scalable, and sustainable cloud solutions. We are proud partners of the cloud hyperscalers AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud and cover a wide range of services – from cloud strategy development and design to implementation and ongoing optimization.
We build AI and cloud infrastructures for renowned customers such as EON, HDI, Allianz, KfW, Badenova, Klinikum Landsberg, and ITZ Bund. Our technical expertise is broad and deep, specializing in innovative cloud-native development and app modernization that enables scalable and intelligent solutions.
We are experts in developing future-proof architectures, container orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes, advanced DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines, as well as comprehensive AI and data platforms. This includes enterprise-wide data lakes, advanced data analytics, AI platform integration, and automated MLOps pipelines.
Our corporate culture promotes professionalism, technical excellence, and teamwork. At Pexon Consulting, you will find a challenging and enriching work environment where you can grow alongside a team that is passionate about technology and the success of our customers.
